resources.string: Let someone you trust know when OpenCaller protects you, or look after a family member
Sign in to use family protection. It is free.

Family protection lets someone you trust see that OpenCaller is protecting you, and hear about it when a scammer may be asking for your one-time code during a call. Only what you choose is shared, and nobody can add you without your own code and consent.
You become the group\'s admin. You can invite up to 4 people. As the admin you share nothing; your members choose what they share with you.
For example Mum, Rafi or Grandpa
Enter the 8-character code the group\'s admin gave you. You will see what joining means before anything is shared.
%1$s is the group\'s admin. Choose what %1$s may see:
When a one-time code arrives while you are on a call with a stranger, or many codes arrive at once, %1$s gets a message that it happened. Not the code, and not who called or texted.
Once a day, how many calls OpenCaller blocked and how many messages it filtered as spam or scam on your phone. Only these two numbers. %1$s sees the last 7 days.
Who called or texted you, any phone numbers, your messages, your contacts, your call history or where you are.
You can turn each of these off, or leave the group, at any time in Protection → Family protection. Turning something off deletes what the server kept of it.
I chose to join, and I understand what %1$s will see.
